_note: Reviewed list of the Gate options (ORISO-Docs#211). The field does NOT exist yet: a project admin creates it with createField below. Do not rename options without updating board-contract.json, watchers.config.json and map/board-agg.js (tests compare all four).

criteria.de: Das Problem und das gewünschte Ergebnis stehen im Issue; Epic und Fähigkeit sind bekannt.
criteria.en: Problem and desired outcome are written in the issue; epic and capability are known.

options.name: P2 Specified
options.description: Acceptance criteria and test plan written

criteria.de: Abnahmekriterien und Testplan sind geschrieben; offene Fragen sind beantwortet.
criteria.en: Acceptance criteria and test plan are written; open questions are answered.

options.name: P3 Sliced
options.description: Cut into agent-sized slices, effort set

criteria.de: In Teile geschnitten, die ein Agent in einem Pull Request schafft; Aufwand ist gesetzt.
criteria.en: Cut into slices an agent can finish in one pull request; effort is set.

options.name: P4 Ready for agent
options.description: Last planning gate: an agent may start

criteria.de: P1 bis P3 erfüllt, Priorität, Readiness und Release gesetzt, kein offener Blocker; Status ist Ready.
criteria.en: P1 to P3 met, priority, readiness and release set, no open blocker; status is Ready.

criteria.de: Pull Request ist offen und alle Prüfungen (Build, Tests, Lint) sind grün.
criteria.en: Pull request is open and all checks (build, tests, lint) are green.

criteria.de: Die KI-Prüfung ist durch; Befunde sind behoben oder beantwortet.
criteria.en: The AI review passed; findings are fixed or answered.

options.name: R3 Human review
options.description: A human reviewed and approved the code

criteria.de: Ein Mensch hat den Code geprüft und den Pull Request freigegeben.
criteria.en: A human reviewed the code and approved the pull request.

options.name: R4 Verified on Dev
options.description: Merged and checked on Dev (QA internal)

criteria.de: Gemergt und auf Dev geprüft; Status ist QA internal. Danach gilt der bestehende Ablauf (QA external, Done).
criteria.en: Merged and checked on Dev; status is QA internal. After that the existing lifecycle applies (QA external, Done).

createField.gh: gh project field-create 1 --owner OpenResilienceInitiative --name Gate --data-type SINGLE_SELECT --single-select-options "P1 Framed,P2 Specified,P3 Sliced,P4 Ready for agent,R1 Checks green,R2 AI review,R3 Human review,R4 Verified on Dev"
createField.graphql: gh api graphql -f project=PVT_kwDODkeBP84BHH8p -f query='mutation($project: ID!) { createProjectV2Field(input: {projectId: $project, dataType: SINGLE_SELECT, name: "Gate", singleSelectOptions: [{name: "P1 Framed", color: GRAY, description: "Problem and outcome are stated"}, {name: "P2 Specified", color: GRAY, description: "Acceptance criteria and test plan written"}, {name: "P3 Sliced", color: GRAY, description: "Cut into agent-sized slices, effort set"}, {name: "P4 Ready for agent", color: BLUE, description: "Last planning gate: an agent may start"}, {name: "R1 Checks green", color: YELLOW, description: "Pull request open, CI green"}, {name: "R2 AI review", color: YELLOW, description: "AI review passed, findings handled"}, {name: "R3 Human review", color: ORANGE, description: "A human reviewed and approved the code"}, {name: "R4 Verified on Dev", color: GREEN, description: "Merged and checked on Dev (QA internal)"}]}) { projectV2Field { ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { id name options { id name } } } } }'
